title: Göbekli Tepe as an astronomical calendar tracking the Great Year

tellings.quote: because look at the pillars of quec Tepe have they're just basically star constellations

plain: Göbekli Tepe, an ancient site of carved stone pillars in Turkey, may have worked as a sky calendar, with pillars that are really pictures of star constellations. That is the reading of a researcher named Matt LaCroix, who gives it on Michels's show in 2024 without naming a source. If he is right, the people who built it were tracking the slow turning of the stars over very long ages.
